title: What to know about this year’s UN climate talks
summary:
This annual gathering can often serve as an indicator of where the world stands on addressing and adapting to the climate crisis.
And this year’s talks are sure to be a doozy—expect a lot of back and forth on fossil fuels and climate finance in particular.
President Trump formally withdrew the country from the Paris Agreement earlier this year and is in the process of withdrawing from the UN Framework Committee on Climate Change.
Meanwhile, things aren’t looking good for the Paris Agreement, which was established at UN climate talks 11 years ago, setting a goal of limiting warming to 1.5 °C over preindustrial levels.
There’s also the major issue of how to pay for efforts to address emissions and to help a warming world endure the inevitable damage.

title: COP31: Burnham says climate consensus 'gone' but pledges 'new era of leadership'
summary:
Prime Minister Andy Burnham has warned that the consensus on both science and climate change has "gone".

He said "it was not normal" - in fact it was the hottest on record, made 130 times more likely because of climate change, according to the Met Office.

title: Watch: Inside Ukraine power plant under constant drone threat
summary:

title: ‘Everything and everyone we love is at stake’: Thunberg slams COP31 talks
summary:
Climate activist urges world leaders to put people and planet before profit as she arrives at UN climate talks.
Share ‘Everything and everyone we love is at stake’: Thunberg slams COP31 talks on social mediaSwedish climate activist Greta Thunberg has condemned the United Nations climate talks as hypocritical and urged world leaders to put people and planet ahead of profits and power.
Thunberg made the comments on Tuesday as she arrived at the COP31 conference in the Turkish resort city of Antalya.
Climate change is “threatening everything”, Thunberg said, warning that “everything and everyone we love is at stake”.
Her arrival in Antalya has created excitement among many of the youth climate activists at COP31 who are demanding more climate finance.
